approvers: Spouse/co-owner, my tax adviser, my lawyer
reason: The terms are cleaner than I expected and a free first meeting costs me nothing, so I will listen. But 3.5 to 4.5 times EBITDA with 10% held back for a year is not the highest cash offer, and I take the highest cash at closing, so I expect someone else to pay more.
objection: I expect a higher price; others will pay more in cash at closing. And they have no earlier sellers to vouch for them, so my wife will ask why we should wait a year for 10% from a company nobody has dealt with.
instead: List the business on nexxt-change and take the best cash offer from other buyers, or keep working a few more years and wind down if nobody pays enough.
would_change_my_mind: 100% cash at closing at the top of the range or above, plus a reference from someone I can phone who has actually sold to them.
